label: Companies by Domains

headings.className: section-header-label section-header-label--rule block! border-b pb-3 text-c-1 responses-title--tree mt-3 mb-0 block! leading-[1.45] font-medium

paragraphs: Find companies by their domains. How it works: Provide a list of company domains (up to 1000) The system looks up each domain and returns at most one company profile per domain (the best match by quality score) Pricing: 0.5 credit(s) per company found 0 credits for domains not found Limits: Maximum 1000 domains per request Maximum 10000 companies per response Deduplication: Pass dedup list ids in exclude_lists — matched companies are not returned and not charged
Request payload for companies search by domains (bulk).
Request payload for companies search by domains (bulk).

domainsType: array of string 1…1000max length: 256requiredExample["bmw.com", "mercedes-benz.com", "audi.com"]Copy link to domains List of company domains (max 1000). Each domain will be normalized. exclude_listsType: array of string …100nullableExample["9f6c1c2e-1f7d-4b1a-9a55-3f1f8a2a4b10"]Copy link to exclude_lists Ids of your dedup lists (see Deduplication endpoints). Results already present in these lists are excluded and never charged. When set, the free results zone does not apply. Max 100 lists / 500000 values combined per request.
List of company domains (max 1000). Each domain will be normalized.
